newsitem.title: SPAIN: Basque rebels ETA claim 15 attacks, two fatal.
newsitem.headline: Basque rebels ETA claim 15 attacks, two fatal.

text.p: Basque separatist rebel group ETA claimed responsibility on Tuesday for 15 attacks in the last five months, including two fatal shootings.

A statement in radical Basque nationalist newspaper Egin, ETA's usual mouthpiece, said the group was responsible for the killings of a police officer on April 24 and a civil guardsman on May 3 as well as an attempted assassination on April 16 and several bombs, one of which injured a construction worker in Seville.

ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom), which has killed some 800 people since 1968 in a campaign of bombings, shootings and grenade attacks, also warned the population at large to avoid touching "suspicious packages".
ETA is seeking an independent Basque homeland encompassing parts of northern Spain and southern France.
